window_boundaries: Cumulative days since publication: [0,30), [0,90), [0,365). Incremental [30,90) and [90,365) require paired complete observations.
study_unit: One eligible video, with owner-authorized financial series only when consent and usage rights allow

labels.evergreen: Searchable persistent-intent content classified prior to measuring outcomes
labels.trend_or_event: Event, release, news, seasonal or short-horizon topical content classified prior to measuring outcomes

metric_types.limitation: Events not people; 2026-08-24 count definition break, Shorts engaged views separate.
Estimated native YouTube revenue can be revised; not external sponsorship/merch, before cash production costs, sometimes impossible to allocate fully per video.
Search, Browse, Suggested, External are different sources; no causal longevity inference.

right_censoring: Every age horizon must be observed through its final day; missing days are unknown, not zero. Compare complete cohorts and separately report enrollment and attrition.
population_rules: Include zero-view and never-monetized entrant videos if ethically and methodologically observable.
Never treat only currently monetized channels as typical of all entrants.
Classify evergreen/trend before looking at outcome curves; prospective classification must not leak view counts.
Keep long form, Shorts, live replay, language, geographic market and currencies separated.
Use identical publication-age windows and publish the viewer-metric revision era.
Do not use ordinary CPM/RPM to assign a public video's owner earnings; get authorized creator statements for financial outcome.
Do not conflate lifetime views with calendar-month views, or search traffic with guaranteed evergreen cash flow.
Review holidays/release cycles and date cohort censoring instead of attributing short-term spikes to platform-wide growth.

acceptance_gates.reason: No first-time-publisher representative sampling frame or preregistered inclusion exclusions.
No accessible, independently source-documented 30/90/365-day video-level panel with complete zeros and missingness.
Native revenue, sponsor receipts, creator work hours and expenses unavailable for a representative cohort.
No predeclared matching, selection analysis, monetization eligibility and geographic/time-window uncertainty.
